notes.title: Fixes + Demo
notes.content:
[list]
[*] [b]Demo Available[/b]
[/list]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the Archer's upgraded Kill Shot card caused the game to become stuck.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Reward Screen closed when a consumable was the last item to loot.
[*] Reduced the cost of Shop Upgrade Points from 125 to 100.
[*] The Scepter now sets the card upgrade cost to 40 instead of 60.
[*] The Scepter now also sets the refresh cost to 10.
[*] The Scepter and Persuasive Tool now update shop prices immediately upon purchase; previously, a shop refresh was required.
[*] Average rewards in coins have been increased for Normal/Elite/Boss encounters by 8/16/18.
[*] Mongrel's Push Attack now pushes the target only once.
[*] The Ancient Ent no longer attempts to cast an Unknown attack.
[*] The Rage buff is now correctly displayed on the Ancient Ent.
[*] The damage of the Ancient Ent's Slam Attack has been reduced from 30 to 27.
[*] Rest Heal at the Campfire has been increased from 20 to 35.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix #2 for this clown game

[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.content:
[b]Fixed issue when:[/b]

[list]
[*] When upgrading cards was only possible after opening the deck for the second time
[*] Cards can be upgraded only by clicking on Upgrade icon (cogwheel icon below deck).
[*] Mage card - Curse of Sensation was cast twice.
[*] Mage card - Curse of Sensation gave wrong effect.
[*] Yellow Slug's curse was not showing poperly.
[*] Sigil buff often dropped when other debuff was already applied. 
[*] Mana tooltip added to Sealed Book artefact.
[*] From now Hero's Health is increased by 50 after each boss.
[*] Steel Guardian's artificial strength reduced from 10 to 5.
[*] Steel Guardian's Claw Attack reduced from 30 to 25.
[*] Indicator icon of Steel Guardian's multi-attack is shown correctly now.
[*] Mongrel's Heavy Slash attack reduced from 21 to 19.
[*] Added name animation at start of combat.
[*] Watcher's Left Eye now casting Magic Armor on self properly.
[*] Initiative of Fox and Rat companion increased, should now attack before rivals.
[/list]
